baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled يَأْتِيكُمَا encloses طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ and places نَبَّأْتُكُمَا before the second arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: An allocated item of subsistence is on its way, while the speaker claims an informational lead over its arrival. On the most local reading, he can identify or account for each meal before it reaches the two hearers.

activation_trace.role: The repeated arrival supplies the event whose timing brackets the claim.
Tasting and eating keep the immediate object concretely meal-like.
The livelihood branch widens the meal into provisioned subsistence.
Allocated giving marks the food as a received share rather than a self-produced object.
A report that reaches its hearers supplies the advance disclosure.
Precedence gives the report a measurable lead over the arriving meal.

changed_reading.before: The sentence is a general assertion of interpretive ability.
changed_reading.after: The sentence first presents a concrete prison-scale test: an allotted meal cannot arrive without the speaker's report getting there first.

baseline_models.mechanism: The return-to-outcome branch of تَأْوِيل makes the promise larger than naming a menu. The speaker claims to state where an arriving matter tends or terminates while that matter is still approaching, so explanation is prospective rather than retrospective.

activation_trace.role: The delivered report gives the model its communicative act.
Return to a final outcome makes interpretation an account of what the matter becomes.
Temporal priority places that outcome-account before manifestation.
The avenue and readiness of an event supply a process that can be read before completion.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation explains an opaque sign after it has been presented.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation is advance access to a matter's trajectory: its ending can become reportable before its event becomes present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّى إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ ... وَهُم ... كَافِرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse places received knowledge beside departure from a communal creed. It does not explicitly state a causal equation, but it presents interpretive authority as accountable to a Lord and as incompatible with a social path that withholds assent and covers truth.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the claimed epistemic gift.
Knowledge attributed to the Lord identifies the source to which the method answers.
Deliberate release from something supplies the negative act of epistemic separation.
A followed creed supplies the inherited system from which the speaker separates.
Settled assent supplies the positive epistemic relation that the group lacks.
Obstruction of truth supplies the failure against which the claimed teaching is positioned.

changed_reading.before: The creed statement is a digression after a claim of special knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The creed statement is part of the credential: how one receives and reports outcomes is tied to which authority and communal path one refuses or trusts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair of dream reports explicitly asks for an interpretation, and one dream already contains carried bread being eaten. This reopens the focus sentence: its food can remain a literal meal forecast, but it can also function as a compact demonstration that the requested dream-food has an outcome knowable before enactment.

activation_trace.role: Concrete food keeps the local antecedent of the pronoun alive.
Return to outcome lets the same wording reach beyond a menu to a dream's realized end.
Repeated dream-vision supplies the symbolic container to which an outcome-reading can answer.
The request for a delivered report anticipates the focus speaker's promise to report.
The explicit request for an outcome-return supplies the discourse-level referent of the focus claim.
Consumption turns the carried bread from a static image into a future event-chain.

structural_cues: 12:36 contains two first-person visions and ends with an explicit request using the same report-and-interpretation construction that 12:37 answers.
The food imagery is split across the literal meal in 12:37 and dream bread in 12:36, so neither antecedent should be forced to eliminate the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent request, the repeated report/interpretation roots, and dream food; I infer that the meal claim demonstrates command of dream outcomes. A live alternative is a literal prediction of prison meals inserted before any dream explanation.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun in بِتَأْوِيلِهِ points only to the arriving food.
changed_reading.after: The pronoun remains locally food-linked while the preceding request activates a second reading: food is also the test case through which dream interpretation proves it can outrun fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts an inherited path, scattered lords, and self-assigned names lacking compelling warrant with one source of judgment and accurate knowledge. On this reading, تَأْوِيل is anti-nominal: it does not merely attach labels to signs but returns them to coherent consequences under an accountable authority.

activation_trace.role: Known disclosure supplies the positive alternative to unsupported naming.
Lord-derived knowledge gives interpretation an accountable source.
Following in another's track supplies the mechanism of inherited epistemic continuity.
A creed that is followed supplies the positive counterpart to the creed left in the focus.
Dispersion into pieces supplies the rival model of fragmented authority.
Unshared divine unity supplies the single authority under which disparate signs can cohere.
Names as markers supply the possibility of designation without explanatory purchase.
Compelling warrant supplies the criterion that the invented names lack.
Knowledge that lands correctly supplies the standard for a consequential interpretation.

structural_cues: 12:38 answers تركت with اتبعت, making departure and following paired epistemic motions.
12:39-40 move from scattered masters to one God and then from invented names to judgment, authority, and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited following, fragmented versus unitary authority, unsupported naming, and judgment; I infer that this sequence also describes what separates valid interpretation from arbitrary labeling. It may instead be an independent exhortation placed before, but not methodologically tied to, the dream answer.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's monotheistic declaration establishes only his religious identity.
changed_reading.after: The declaration also proposes an epistemic ethic: a true interpretation must do more than name signs, because it is answerable to coherent outcomes and warranted judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two requested answers become mutually exclusive embodied futures, and the sequence closes by declaring the matter completed. This strengthens تَأْوِيل as disclosure of an outcome that will take effect, not a detachable symbolic gloss.

activation_trace.role: The matter's return to its endpoint supplies the semantic core that the later fates enact.
A requested decisive answer frames interpretation as a determination sought from the speaker.
Actual eating carries the earlier food image into an embodied terminal event.
Completion and exhaustion of the matter close off a merely tentative reading.

structural_cues: 12:41 resolves the paired dreamers with an أما ... وأما distribution and then closes with قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two enacted fates and a completion formula; I infer that this realization clarifies the force of تَأْوِيل in 12:37. The completion formula could refer only to the decree about these two men rather than define interpretation generally.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation is an informative account that may remain separate from what follows.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation exposes the event's binding endpoint; the explanation is verified when the image becomes a lived fate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after proving advance knowledge, the speaker tries to use human remembrance to alter his own confinement, but forgetting intervenes and he remains. The sequence blocks an inflation of the focus claim: knowing an arrival before it occurs does not entail causing, accelerating, or controlling one's desired arrival.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the temporal event over which the speaker claims knowledge but not explicit control.
Informational precedence is the limited capacity being tested.
Recall supplies the proposed human relay from prison knowledge to release.
Loss of remembrance breaks the proposed relay.
Continued residence supplies the prolonged result of that broken relay.

structural_cues: The command ٱذْكُرْنِى is followed by forgetting and then by a quantified multi-year stay in prison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies foreknowledge, an attempted remembrance relay, its failure, and prolonged confinement; I infer a boundary between epistemic access and schedule control. The delay can also be read simply as plot causation, without qualifying the earlier claim.

changed_reading.before: Advance knowledge suggests broad mastery over coming events.
changed_reading.after: Advance knowledge is real but bounded: the speaker can disclose another's outcome while remaining unable to hasten his own transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The royal vision is converted into a timed chain of cultivation, restrained consumption, protected storage, severe depletion, relief, and renewed extraction. This activates the focus cluster of food, allotted provision, advance outcome, and Lord-taught knowledge as a control system: interpretation creates lead time in which future scarcity can be survived.

activation_trace.role: Food as livelihood supplies the population-scale resource being governed.
An allotted share supplies the distributive dimension of future provisioning.
Taking charge of an affair activates the packet's split-root possibility that interpretation includes governance.
A royal dream supplies the compressed forecast that must be unfolded into action.
Cultivation and growth begin the planned resource cycle.
Leaving grain in place supplies deliberate non-consumption as preservation.
Protection within an enclosure supplies reserve security against the consuming years.
Relief of the afflicted supplies the reversal after scarcity.
Extracted yield supplies renewed productive abundance at the end of the cycle.

structural_cues: 12:43-49 turns sevenfold dream images into an ordered multi-year program rather than stopping at prediction.
The program explicitly controls how much is eaten, what remains protected, what future years consume, and when relief resumes production.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forecast and every stage of the agricultural sequence; I infer the directional arrow that interpretation functions as anticipatory governance. A live alternative is that prophecy and practical advice are adjacent but conceptually separable acts.

changed_reading.before: Knowing food before it arrives is a private sign of extraordinary perception.
changed_reading.after: Knowing provision ahead of arrival is socially operative lead time: the interpretation becomes a storage and rationing policy that preserves a population.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the king orders the speaker brought, the summons does not produce immediate arrival. He returns the messenger, demands inquiry, and waits for truth to emerge. The focus formula of report-before-arrival is thus reenacted procedurally: a verified account must reach the court before the interpreter himself does.

activation_trace.role: A report reaching another party supplies the informational object that can precede transfer.
Precedence supplies the procedural ordering later applied to the speaker's own arrival.
The king's command to bring him makes the interpreter's physical arrival the pending event.
Sending the messenger back interrupts immediate transfer and creates an investigative interval.
Questioning supplies the inquiry through which the prior report is produced.
Truth emerging into visibility supplies the report's public arrival.
Established and displayed truth supplies the verified content required before movement.

structural_cues: The command ٱئْتُونِى بِهِ is suspended by ٱرْجِعْ ... فَسْـَٔلْهُ, and the inquiry concludes with ٱلْـَٰٔنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons, a returned messenger, an inquiry, and public truth; I infer that their order reenacts the focus's report-before-arrival pattern. A live alternative is that the delay serves personal exoneration alone and does not generalize into an interpretive ethic.

changed_reading.before: Before-arrival knowledge is only a claim about external events or meals.
changed_reading.after: Before-arrival knowledge becomes a practiced procedure: verified meaning should arrive before the person, office, or consequence built upon it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby discourse joins knowledge to fidelity when unobserved, then refuses simple self-acquittal and admits an internally commanding self except where mercy intervenes. This revises the focus credential: leaving a truth-covering creed does not make the knower self-validating; trustworthy interpretation also requires fidelity under absence and suspicion toward one's own motives.

activation_trace.role: Claimed disclosure supplies the knowledge whose ethical conditions are being qualified.
Blocking truth supplies the external failure that cannot by itself certify the one who rejects it.
Deficient fidelity supplies the ethical corruption opposed to reliable reporting.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the condition under which fidelity cannot depend on observation.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies a path that treacherous plotting fails to reach.
Disavowal of complete innocence blocks self-certification.
The inward faculty of judgment supplies a possible source of distortion inside the knower.
Merciful tenderness supplies the exception that prevents the self's pressure from being absolute.

structural_cues: 12:52-53 moves from truth known under absence to non-acquittal of the self, internal pressure toward wrong, and mercy.
The packet does not mark a speaker change across these statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fidelity in absence, failed guidance of betrayal, non-acquittal, an inward command, and mercy; I infer that they qualify the focus claim of Lord-taught knowledge. A materially live alternative is that 12:52-53 changes speaker, making this a contextual ethical frame rather than the interpreter's own self-qualification.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting the unbelieving creed and citing divine teaching are sufficient self-credentials.
changed_reading.after: The credential remains accountable and non-triumphal: truth must be kept when unseen, while the interpreter's own inward judgment remains subject to suspicion and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interpreter is selected, empowered, called trustworthy, and then claims fitness over the storehouses through the paired capacities of guarding and knowing. This strongly activates the split mapping of تَأْوِيل toward taking charge: advance understanding of provision matures into accountable custody of the material system it disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the exploratory governance dimension of interpretation.
Livelihood supplies the material domain that later comes under custody.
Disclosed knowledge supplies one half of the later administrative qualification.
Selection into exclusive service moves the interpreter from confinement toward office.
Empowerment supplies the capacity to implement rather than merely announce.
Settled trust supplies the social authorization required for custody.
The keeper responsible for preservation supplies the concrete office.
Active guarding supplies the operational complement to foresight.
Knowledge reappears as an explicit qualification for administering the stores.

structural_cues: 12:54 pairs مَكِينٌ with أَمِينٌ; 12:55 then pairs حَفِيظٌ with عَلِيمٌ over the storehouses.
12:56 narrates actual establishment in the land, confirming that the requested capacity becomes operative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, empowerment, trust, storehouses, guarding, and knowledge; I infer that these realize a governance potential in the split-root inventory of تَأْوِيل. The conservative alternative keeps interpretation and later administration distinct, with only narrative qualification linking them.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation is a verbal gift displayed to two prisoners.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation is the first form of custodianship: accurate anticipation of provision qualifies the knower to guard, allocate, and administer it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context returns explicitly to the afterlife, belief, protective conduct, and a better reward. It places the focus's rapid knowledge-before-arrival claim inside a second temporal scale: immediate provision can be forecast and managed, but ultimate value belongs to a later recompense.

activation_trace.role: Near precedence supplies the short horizon of advance knowledge.
What comes after the first horizon supplies the ultimate temporal frame already named in the focus.
Settled assent links that later horizon to the focus's contrast in belief.
Recompense for action supplies the value realized beyond immediate subsistence.
The later realm explicitly reactivates the focus's long horizon.
Believing assent identifies those oriented to the later reward.
Placing oneself under protection supplies sustained conduct between present provision and final recompense.

structural_cues: 12:57 closes the packet window by repeating both afterlife and belief from the focus while adding reward and protective conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a short before-arrival interval and a closing later-reward interval; I infer a nested temporal model in which logistical foresight remains subordinate to eschatological valuation. The closing line may instead function as a general coda without specifically reframing 12:37.

changed_reading.before: The verse's temporal interest is exhausted by predicting what arrives next.
changed_reading.after: The verse holds two clocks together: near provision can be known and managed ahead of time, while the worth of belief and conduct is disclosed on the farther horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from focus ق و ل to ق ل ل and should not be treated as the lexical meaning of قَالَ. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated when the later plan twice says only a little may be eaten or retained. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root resonance: the speaker's saying becomes effective as calibrated scarcity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ at the opening of 12:37, resolved through the packet's secondary ق ل ل target.

activation_trace.role: The secondary fewness branch lets the opening speech carry an exploratory resonance of measured limitation.
The first explicit small remainder turns interpretation into a rule limiting present consumption.
The second small remainder confirms scarcity as the practical register of the earlier saying.

changed_reading.before: قَالَ merely introduces a speech about interpretation.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's split-root edge, the speech itself becomes a measure: its truth is operationalized by saying how little may be consumed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the agricultural branch of ك ف ر is distant from the ordinary force of كَافِرُونَ. It remains valid as a contrast because the branch is focus-anchored and the later context supplies cultivation plus protected grain. Downstream prose should not redefine unbelief as farming; it should qualify the activation as a distinction between destructive concealment of truth and protective covering that preserves future life.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَافِرُونَ in 12:37, carrying both truth-obstruction and the packet's seed-covering branch.

activation_trace.role: Obstruction of truth supplies the culpable kind of covering named in the focus.
Covering seed supplies a materially productive counter-image within the same focus inventory.
Cultivation supplies the scene in which hidden seed can generate rather than suppress life.
Leaving grain in its protective setting supplies deliberate concealment for future use.
Enclosed preservation supplies the protective counterpart to truth-obstructing concealment.

changed_reading.before: Covering is a uniformly negative image for refusal of truth.
changed_reading.after: The agricultural context differentiates coverings by function: covering truth blocks life-giving knowledge, while covering and enclosing seed can preserve life through a future crisis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مِلَّة in the sentence straightforwardly denotes a creed, while the hot-ash branch is materially remote. It remains packet-anchored, and the immediately preceding dream supplies bread and eating that can activate that dormant image. Downstream prose should retain creed as the translation and mention hot ash only as a contained material analogy for a social medium that turns and forms what passes through it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِلَّةَ in the departure clause of 12:37, with its creed branch primary and hot-ash branch latent.

activation_trace.role: The followed creed supplies the explicit social and religious referent.
Hot material in which bread is turned supplies the dormant formative analogy.
Bread in the adjacent dream activates the otherwise remote cooking image.
Consumption makes the formed product consequential rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Leaving a creed means only changing stated affiliation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, leaving a creed is exiting a formative heat-bed that turns what a community produces and consumes, before offering a differently sourced nourishment.

strongest_changes: The literal meal forecast remains live, but 12:36 and 12:41 turn it into a second reading in which dream images disclose embodied outcomes before fulfillment.
12:43-49 transforms interpretation from private foreknowledge into anticipatory famine governance through cultivation, restraint, storage, relief, and renewed yield.
12:50-51 reenacts report-before-arrival as a procedure: verified truth reaches authority before the interpreter accepts transfer.
12:54-56 joins knowledge to trust, guarding, and storehouse office, activating تَأْوِيل as custodial implementation as well as explanation.
12:42 prevents overreach by separating advance knowledge from control over the timing of one's own release.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse latent-links food, provision, outcome, precedence, teaching, creed, belief, and covering. The context does not resolve these into one thesis: it successively activates dream fulfillment, anti-nominal authority, logistical planning, procedural truth, ethical self-suspicion, administrative custody, and a farther afterlife clock.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and scope of بِتَأْوِيلِهِ remain productively double: literal arriving food and the requested dream matter both retain syntactic or discourse support.
The packet does not settle speaker continuity in 12:52-53, so ethical self-qualification may be direct speech or a contextual frame.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل, ك ف ر seed-covering, and م ل ل hot-ash activations are packet-resolved but deliberately exploratory; none should displace the primary lexical readings.
The governance sense activated through the non-dominant و ل ي target may describe what interpretation becomes in the narrative rather than what تَأْوِيل itself lexically means.
